source: Wiwynn press release: Wiwynn Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results (08-07-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue was NT$278.153 billion, up 26.0% YoY, and profit after tax NT$14.969 billion, up 23.5%; gross margin improved to 9.3% (operating margin 7.3%, PAT margin 5.4%), EPS NT$80.43 vs NT$65.23. From April, memory procurement for certain customers shifted to a procurement agency model, with the related amounts excluded from revenue and cost of goods sold; together with higher NRE income from a new product introduction this lifted gross margin. In response to changes in the AI product mix and rising component costs, the company has continued to work with customers to adjust its business model. H1 2026 revenue was NT$554.660 billion, up 41.7% YoY; PAT NT$29.084 billion, up 32.7%; EPS NT$156.38 vs NT$117.93, a record for the period.

quarterly_data.signal: The company says it is optimistic about the long-term growth of the AI and data center markets; to support business growth and global capacity expansion the Board approved a consolidated capital expenditure budget of US$942 million for the second half of 2026, primarily for power infrastructure, equipment, land and buildings.
